validation.notes: Repaired migrateSessionsFromAgentRoot() in packages/coding-agent/src/migrations.ts: the legacy ~/.pi/agent/*.jsonl migration used a bare renameSync(file, newPath), which on POSIX replaces an existing destination file, destroying the newer session's bytes and removing the legacy copy. Added a single guard ('if (existsSync(newPath)) continue;') so the pre-existing destination always wins, both copies stay byte-identical, and the loop continues with unrelated legacy sessions. The regression loads the real production module through .prale-eval/subject.mjs with only process boundaries faked (chalk, CONFIG_DIR_NAME, getAgentDir, getBinDir, migrateKeybindingsConfig, stripBom) and uses the real fs inside a throwaway directory under .prale-eval, so genuine rename/overwrite semantics are exercised; it seeds a colliding legacy session plus two unrelated legacy sessions, runs the migration, and asserts the destination is byte-for-byte unchanged, the colliding source still exists with its own bytes, the unrelated sessions moved with intact bytes, and a full file-tree snapshot matches exactly (no duplicate or deleted copies). Verified exit 0 on the repaired code and exit 1 with 'ASSERTION FAILED: existing destination session was modified or overwritten by the migration' when the guard was temporarily removed (original fault). The temporary fault copy was restored to the fixed version; .prale-eval temp directories are removed in a finally block. Limitation: node_modules is absent and dependencies may not be installed, so the repository's own vitest/biome suites could not be run; the standalone Node 24 regression (no dependencies, no network) is the validation executed.
